QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] What Is He?
QuestInfo.0: The mysterious man was the Pale Student Teacher. What's his true identity?
QuestInfo.1: The Pale Student Teacher knew all about you. He disappeared after summoning the Troublemaker. Defeat the Troublemaker.
QuestInfo.2: The Pale Student Teacher said something very significant. Return to Henesys and talk to Grendel the Really Old.
